one_line_input: Quiet Desk hero video — animate the already-built hero still (records/assets/hero-still.png) into a subtle, looping 5-8s image-to-video background for a headline to sit on top of.
big_idea: The measurement keeps running even when nothing else moves — proof, not a mood, stays alive in the frame.
visual_description: The exact scene from the source still (the mechanical switch set and matched desk mat on a measurement rig, ruler/scale bar along one edge, calibration-yellow dB-meter or waveform readout near the switches, matte-black surface, clear matte-black/instrument-grey space across the upper third) with one subtle motion layered on top: either a slow, minimal camera push-in toward the rig, a faint ambient drift across the surface, or the dB-meter/waveform readout gently animating as if actively measuring. Only one of these motion types should drive the shot, kept understated enough that a still frame grabbed at any point looks nearly identical to the source image. The loop runs 5-8 seconds and returns seamlessly to its start with no visible jump or cut.
style_notes: Same instrument-grade, precise, calibration-bench read as the source still — nothing about the motion should feel cinematic, lifestyle, or stylized. Motion reads like equipment quietly doing its job (a meter live-reading, a lens creeping in on a lab shot), not like a product video with camera work. Matte black and instrument grey dominate throughout; calibration yellow (#FFC800) stays exactly where it was in the source still, used only for the readout digits/tick marks.
must_preserve: colors stay locked exactly to the source still — no new color grading, hue shift, or lighting change introduced by the motion
no new object enters the frame at any point in the loop — this is a background a headline sits on top of, so nothing may appear that competes with text legibility
motion stays subtle and singular — a slow push-in, ambient drift, or the dB-meter/waveform readout animating, never combined, never fast, never a pan or shake
the upper third of the frame stays clear, uncluttered matte-black/instrument-grey space reserved for a future headline overlay for the entire duration of the loop
the loop is seamless — the final frame returns to the first without a visible jump, cut, or reset
no readable text, logo, or wordmark renders anywhere in the video, at any frame — same rule as the source still
stays within the established visual pillars: instrument/lab palette, measurement-rig product photography with scale reference, spec-sheet dashboard layout language, no lifestyle staging
forbidden: no new text, logo, watermark, or on-screen graphic of any kind appearing at any point in the motion
no new object, prop, hand, or person entering frame during the loop
no camera movement beyond a slow, minimal push-in or ambient drift — no pans, zoom-outs, whip movements, handheld shake, or cuts
no color or lighting shift that diverges from the source still's locked palette
no scene changes, transitions, or multiple shots within the loop — one continuous take
no gamer-RGB aesthetic, glossy render motion, or esports visual language
no lifestyle desk flat-lay staging introduced through motion (e.g. steam, ambient warm light drift)
